## Board

The layer-matrix **Board** presentation element: a generic kanban over any cards, consuming `KanbanPlane` from boxel-ui (drag engine, columns, WIP limits come free — consume, don't rebuild). The block adds the card-level contract: `@items` (CardDef[]), `@columns` ({key,label,color?}[]), `@columnKeyFor(item)`, and `@onMove(item, columnKey)` fired when a drag crosses columns — the consumer persists (e.g. set `stage`). Cards render via their own fitted format by default (the board provides the `fitted-card` container); pass a `<:card as |item|>` block to customize.

```gts
import { Board } from '../board';
<Board @items={{this.opps}} @columns={{this.stages}} @columnKeyFor={{this.stageOf}} @onMove={{this.setStage}} />
```

The linked example is a demo card mounting the board over the pipeline instances (Opportunity + Deal in one board via adoption).

**Non-goals:** column order persistence and per-card sort order (in-memory only — same open question as App 2's boardOrder), query-driven item loading (consumer's job), interactive children inside cards (drag engine claims pointerdown; stopPropagation wrapper needed — see App 2 findings).
